description.value: Radium Mountainside Market is a local supermarket in Radium Hot Springs, situated at the western entrance to Kootenay National Park along the Columbia Valley cycling corridor. It serves as a key resupply point for touring cyclists traveling through the Kootenays, with Radium Hot Springs being a common overnight stop on multi-day routes.
